title: Launchfolio — product designer case study portfolio
description: A case-study driven portfolio for a product designer. The hero is a real redesign: drag the divider across a checkout and the completion rate, time to pay and field count beside it move from the old numbers to the new ones. Three case studies follow, each built around the shipped interaction: chaptered checkout research, a live upload component, and a design system bento with component layers, token scrubbers and settings tabs, then a seven-week process timeline, team quotes and a project brief form.
features: Before/after checkout hero whose divider drives three result metrics
Case-study folders that peek open and link to each case
Chapter switcher (Problem, Research, Design, Outcome) on a stretch nav
Shipped components shown live: upload chips, component layers, scrub inputs, settings tabs
Project brief form with a stagger menu and demo send state
